full_judgment: 3. Be it mentioned that before the Writ Petition was filed the petitioner filed an application before the Court of Settlement, Dhaka for exclusion of the property from the said list but the Court of Settlement refused to accept the application by assigning reason that the same being barred by limitation and accordingly the Writ Petition No. 5657 of 2003 was filed. However, the respondent Government thereafter filed Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 2351 of 2008 before the Hon'ble Appellate Division challenging the aforesaid judgment and order dated 22-4-2007 passed in Writ Petition No. 5657 of 2003 which was dismissed by the Appellate Division as barred by limitation and, as such, the judgment and order of the High Court Division was upheld.
